question: Where is restaurant situated within 160 kilometers along the travel path toward MVMCC, Novato, CA from Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Golden Gate Bridge Lookout%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MVMCC%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 160000 -- 160 kilometers in meters ) );
